# Lisbon 5-Day Low-Impact City Plan

A relaxed Lisbon itinerary for 2 adults, centered on museums, walking tours, and local food, with one clearly low-cost day and a pace that should stay under **10,000 steps/day** by using trams, taxis, and compact neighborhoods.

## Day-by-Day Itinerary

| Day | Focus | Main Stops | Pace | Est. Spend (2 adults) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sep 10 | Historic center + first tastes | Baixa, Rossio, Praça do Comércio, short Alfama viewpoint walk, dinner in central Lisbon | Light | **€190** |
| Sep 11 | Museum day | Museu Nacional do Azulejo, Museu do Fado area, riverside lunch, relaxed evening in Chiado | Light | **€220** |
| Sep 12 | Low-cost neighborhood day | Belém outdoors, Pastéis de Belém, Jerónimos exterior, riverside stroll, picnic-style meal | **Very light / low-cost** | **€120** |
| Sep 13 | Walking tour + local food | Bairro Alto, Chiado, Time Out Market, optional tram ride, sunset miradouro | Moderate | **€210** |
| Sep 14 | Final museum + easy departure day | Calouste Gulbenkian Museum, nearby café lunch, last shopping, airport transfer | Light | **€160** |

## Daily Plan with Step-Friendly Pacing

### Sep 10: Old Lisbon Welcome
- **Morning:** Check in, then start in **Baixa/Rossio** with flat streets and easy pacing.
- **Afternoon:** Walk to **Praça do Comércio** and take a short, selective visit into **Alfama** only for one viewpoint.
- **Food:** Simple first-night meal in central Lisbon: grilled fish or petiscos near Chiado.
- **Intensity:** Low; keep walking segments short and use taxis between districts if needed.

### Sep 11: Tile Art and Music History
- **Morning:** Visit **Museu Nacional do Azulejo**.
- **Afternoon:** Continue to the **Museu do Fado** area and finish with a slow riverside café stop.
- **Food:** Lunch near the museum route, dinner in **Chiado**.
- **Intensity:** Low; museum-heavy with minimal walking.

### Sep 12: Low-Cost Belém Day
- **Morning:** Go to **Belém** by tram or taxi and focus on outdoor sights.
- **Afternoon:** See the **Jerónimos Monastery exterior**, walk the riverfront, and enjoy **Pastéis de Belém**.
- **Food:** Keep costs down with pastries, coffee, and a casual lunch.
- **Intensity:** Very low; best day to preserve energy and budget.

### Sep 13: Compact Food-and-Views Day
- **Morning:** Explore **Chiado** and **Bairro Alto** with a short guided walking tour.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Time Out Market** for sampling rather than a full meal.
- **Food:** Shared tastings, then a relaxed dinner nearby.
- **Intensity:** Moderate; use tram or ride-hail for any uphill sections.

### Sep 14: Final Culture Stop and Departure
- **Morning:** Visit the **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum**.
- **Afternoon:** Have a calm lunch nearby and leave time for airport transfer.
- **Food:** One final sit-down meal or takeaway before departure.
- **Intensity:** Low; designed to avoid fatigue on the last day.

## Budget Breakdown and Activity Load

### Suggested Budget Split
- **Lodging:** €700–€850
- **Food and drinks:** €420–€520
- **Local transport:** €90–€140
- **Museums and attractions:** €180–€260
- **Buffer for extras:** €80–€150

### Best Visual Format to Present It
- **Budget breakdown:** use a **donut chart** with 5 slices: lodging, food, transport, attractions, buffer.
- **Daily activity intensity:** use a **5-row heat strip** or **bar gauge** for each day:
  - Light
  - Light
  - Very light
  - Moderate
  - Light
- **Travel time between locations:** use a **timeline map card** with each day showing:
  - Start point
  - Next stop
  - Estimated transfer time
  - Transport mode

### Travel Time Guidance
- **Baixa ↔ Chiado:** 10–15 min on foot or 5–10 min by taxi
- **Chiado ↔ Bairro Alto:** 5–10 min on foot
- **Central Lisbon ↔ Belém:** 20–30 min by tram/taxi
- **Central Lisbon ↔ Gulbenkian:** 15–25 min by taxi or metro
- **Airport ↔ City center:** 20–35 min depending on traffic

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Map Itinerary] https://www.google.com/maps
Action: [Button: Museum Tickets] https://www.visitlisboa.com/
Action: [Button: Transit Planner] https://www.carris.pt/en/

## Sources
- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Public transport info: https://www.carris.pt/en/
- Museum reference: https://museudoazulejo.pt/
